hook: Bakery owners: the *holiday rush* paperwork quiz
title: Holiday rush *paperwork* quiz

questions.q: You hire two seasonal helpers for December. Do they need food handler cards?
options: Only if they stay past January
questions.why: Many areas require them for anyone handling food, seasonal or not.

questions.q: You're selling at a weekend holiday market. Does your shop's permit cover the booth?
questions.why: Events often need their own temporary permit. Ask the organizer early.

questions.q: The market wants your COI. Yours expired in September.
questions.why: An expired certificate won't count. Events want current dates.

payoff: How many did you get? Comment your score.
